knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Inspection comes before use, and an unsuitable base or a top-step stance is never acceptable.
Elevated work is limited to people who hold training and authorisation for it.
A loose handrail is reported at once and the section is closed until checked. Taping is not a repair.

practicalCriteria: Considers and states a ground-level option before choosing step equipment
Inspects a step ladder before use and records the result
Withdraws and labels a simulated defective ladder and reports it
Uses a stair with the handrail and reports a simulated loose handrail
passRule: Knowledge checks are a reading check only and are not verified practical competence. Assessor must observe every practical criterion; any failure requires remediation and reassessment.
stopWorkCriteria: A chair, bin or stacked item is used as a base
A person without authorisation works from height
